sentences.en: We began to sail in the direction of the port.
sentences.zh: 我们开始朝着港口的方向航行。

sentences.en: The ships left the port never to be seen again.
sentences.zh: 那些船离开了港口，再也没人见过它们。

sentences.en: Nagasaki, where I was born, is a beautiful port city.
sentences.zh: 我出生的长崎是一个美丽的海港城市。

senses.zh: 港，港口，舱门，码头，机场，(船，飞机的)左舷，[计算机]，端口
